citation: Results from the AI-assisted autonomous weeding study conducted at the Technical University of Munich. Add the full reference here once published.
study_notes: YOLOv11n and YOLOv12n gave the strongest overall detection performance among the five nano-scale generations compared, at mAP@0.5 of about 0.8434 and 0.8405.
Photometric augmentation for fog, night and high-irradiance conditions raised mAP@0.5 from about 0.7767 to about 0.7988, improving generalisation to unseen lighting.
The first ten days after sowing were the most informative window for detection, before canopy growth makes weeds and seedlings harder to separate.
